svg.title: PGx agent orchestration flow
svg.desc: LangGraph flow: START → Research+Memory → Analyst → Validation → conditional branch to Critic/Retry/Fallback → Knowledge → Challenge → END

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What triggers the PGx evaluation pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What do the Research and Memory agents do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Analyst agent do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Validation node check?')
sendPrompt('How does the retry loop work?')
sendPrompt('What does the Critic agent evaluate?')
sendPrompt('How does the Knowledge agent retrieve evidence?')
sendPrompt('What does the Challenge agent do?')
